extracted.intended_audience: Florida state agency staff and officials responsible for scheduling, posting, and publishing notices of public meetings/hearings/workshops; interested members of the public and administrative law practitioners
extracted.subtask_description: Administrative rule setting requirements and amendments for notices of public meetings, hearings, and workshops in Florida, including website posting requirements and timelines for special accommodation requests. Targets agency compliance with state statutory provisions cited in rulemaking authority.
